assign.request: Read the AI's replies aloud: a local voice, a Recite playhead, barge-in (requirements.md)
assign.now: plan written; building recite-server in the worktree

decision.question: Which local text-to-voice model?
decision.why: natural voice, 6x real time on the CPU, so 0 MB of VRAM beside Whisper's 2033 MiB; Chatterbox stays the option for a cloned voice

log.msg: VRAM: whisper-server (large-v3-turbo + silero VAD) holds 2033 MiB; whole card 3657 of 12282 MiB in use. Kokoro on CPU: 11 s of speech in 1.7 s; round trip through Whisper came back word for word; Whisper returns empty text for silence.wav.

Built in worktree task/voice-recite: recite-server (Kokoro, CPU, port 8177) + Process.Recite + /recite proxy; audio/Recite (playhead, barge-in, bar) + Voice personas; the phone sheet reads the smart reply as it streams. Headless proofs: first sound 0.44 s; pause holds the position; back 10 s and restart work; fake-mic speech pauses with Whisper's words; fake wind resumes by itself and the noise floor learns it. Next: docs, review.mjs, hand-off.

decision.question: Where does Recite hear a reply?
options: the session's live wire (Session.stream), as dictation-notes.md recommends
decision.chose: the live wire: one line in ux/Dictate/chat.js calls Recite.shared.from_wire(ev)
decision.why: all three chat views (V1, V2, V3) are fed by that one wire, so read-aloud works whichever chip is on and survives the move to V3

decision.question: Barge-in while the chat's own mic is on?
options: listen to the Dictate mic's level and treat the owner's line on the wire as the check
decision.chose: the Dictate mic's level; the owner's line = speech, no line in 5 s = noise and it resumes
decision.why: never two mics on a phone; Dictate already transcribes, so no second Whisper call

findings.text: At 400 px the Recite control line squeezes its label and progress line to about 40 px, so the label reads only "not…" (Sizing, Wrapping) — shots/127-0-0-1-60498-framework-audio-Recite/400.png, the demo's bottom band. Servex/readme.md, the `ext/` row (line 47), lists `remote/ openrouter/ refine/ local/` but not the new `recite/`. Law 10: index what you create.

Server/readme.md names `plugins/Whisper.js` but not the new `plugins/Recite.js` or its `/recite/*` routes. Server/doc/mobile-lan.md lists `/whisper/*` as a LAN-allowed route, but not `/recite/*`, which has the same guard.

The voice agent coordination ask is not addressed. `Servex/ext/remote/doc/cloud-voice-agent.md` is untouched, and nothing says whether the Claude-app voice agent should hand off to Recite or ignore it. `/recite/*` uses the same `lan()` + `safe_host()` guard as `/whisper/*`, so it should work through the tunnel exactly where Whisper does. That is not proven.

audio/Voice/doc/owner-2026-10-16-voice-conversation.md line 3 still calls Voice "browser `speechSynthesis` only". Voice.js and its readme dropped the `d-voice-engine` reference, and `audio/doc/decisions.md` has no voice entry at all, so the link in that note now points at nothing.

At 1200 px, adding the Voice and Recite tabs pushes the audio tab strip past its width. The Voice page scrolls it so it begins "…ER TRANSCRIBER" (layout.json tabs_gap -276), and the overview cuts "DOCS" at the right edge (shots/127-0-0-1-60498-framework-audio/1200.png, top band).
